 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"such as"** is used to introduce examples of the type of thing that has just been mentioned. (जैसे)

 
 
• **Example: **There are many fruits you can eat,** such as **apples, bananas, and grapes.
 
 
 
• **"such as" **is often used to specify examples and provide clarity by enumerating items that fall under a particular category. (जैसे)
 
 
• **Example: **She enjoys outdoor activities **such as **hiking, cycling, and swimming.
 
• Here in this paragraph, '**such as **justifies the meaning and the theme of the sentence** perfectly.**
 
 

Hence, the correct statement must be '' **such as'** __**being born with special powers, being bitten by a radioactive spider or being exposed to cosmic radiation.....''**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 Other options are** invalid** in this context and is given below.

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Therefore **(अतः): For that reason; consequently.

 
 
• **Example:** He was late, **therefore** he missed the bus.
 
 
 
• **Subsequently **(तत्पश्चात): After a particular thing has happened; afterward.
 
 
• **Example: **She graduated from college and **subsequently** moved to New York.
 
 
 
• **Instead **(इसके बजाय): As an alternative or substitute.
 
 
• **Example:** I was going to go for a walk, but it started raining, so I stayed inside **instead.**
